mission.label: About us
mission.title: Total Charm Dent
mission.missionText: Our mission is to offer patients modern, painless and high-quality dental care. We believe a healthy smile matters for both physical and psycho-emotional wellbeing, and we do everything so that every one of our patients feels it.
mission.visionText: To become one of the most trusted and advanced dental clinics in the Caucasus region, where the patient receives not only quality treatment, but also care, attention and an individual approach.

page.title: The full spectrum of dentistry
page.lead: Five clinical directions and 16 services — from diagnostics to aesthetic restoration. Every stage in one clinic, under the care of one team.
page.ctaLead: Book a first consultation — we examine your mouth, show you the 3D scan and hand you a written treatment plan with stages, timelines and costs.
page.consultationNote: First consultation — 50 ₾, follow-up — 25 ₾. You only pay for treatment once you have approved the plan.

diagnostics-planning.title: Diagnostics and digital planning
diagnostics-planning.blurb: Every course of treatment starts with an accurate picture — imaging and a digital plan the whole team can see at once.
diagnostics-planning.lead: An accurate diagnosis is half the treatment. At a check-up your mouth is examined by a therapist, a prosthodontist and an orthodontist at the same time, 3D tomography shows what the eye cannot, and digital modelling shows you the result before treatment starts. After the case conference you receive a written plan with stages, timelines and costs.
diagnostics-planning.metaDescription: Check-up, 3D computed tomography, visiograph imaging and digital smile design at Total Charm Dent in Vake, Tbilisi.

therapy-prevention.title: Therapy and prevention
therapy-prevention.blurb: Everyday dental care for adults and children — conservative methods, at an unhurried pace.
therapy-prevention.lead: Everyday dentistry — treatment of caries, pulpitis and root canals, professional Air Flow hygiene and gum care. Every procedure is carried out under anaesthetic and with rubber dam isolation. Children are seen only by dentists with paediatric training and years of experience with young patients.
therapy-prevention.metaDescription: Treatment of caries, pulpitis and root canals, professional Air Flow hygiene, paediatric dentistry and periodontology in Vake, Tbilisi.

surgery-implantation.title: Surgery and implantation
surgery-implantation.blurb: Surgical work and implants grounded in a plan, explained in advance, delivered as a calm clinical process.
surgery-implantation.lead: The surgical side covers painless extraction with piezosurgery, removal of wisdom and retained teeth, bone grafting and PRP plasma therapy. For implants we work with surgical guides and with the Straumann, DENTIUM and Bredent SKY systems — from a single tooth to All-on-4 and All-on-6 restorations.
surgery-implantation.metaDescription: Tooth extraction, bone grafting, PRP and dental implants with Straumann, DENTIUM and Bredent SKY systems. All-on-4 and All-on-6 in Tbilisi.

orthodontics.title: Orthodontics
orthodontics.blurb: Correcting how the teeth sit, at any age — classic and invisible systems, built on precise diagnostics.
orthodontics.lead: Bite correction for children, teenagers and adults. We work with the American Orthodontics, FORESTADENT and Damon bracket systems — metal, ceramic and self-ligating — and with clear aligners produced from a 3D scan. The orthodontist chooses the system after diagnostics, based on your clinical picture and what you want aesthetically.
orthodontics.metaDescription: American Orthodontics, FORESTADENT and Damon braces, clear aligners. Orthodontic treatment at Total Charm Dent in Vake, Tbilisi.

aesthetic.title: Aesthetic dentistry
aesthetic.blurb: A natural look built on exact colour, shape and proportion — a result that never reads as "done".
aesthetic.lead: Aesthetic work begins with digital smile design and ends in a material that behaves like natural enamel. Ceramic veneers are milled with CAD/CAM technology and need minimal preparation, composite restoration rebuilds shape in one or two visits, and ZOOM 4 whitening lifts the enamel by up to eight shades.
aesthetic.metaDescription: CAD/CAM ceramic veneers, aesthetic restoration and ZOOM 4 teeth whitening at Total Charm Dent, Tbilisi.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.blurb: Check-up — a comprehensive oral examination and a rational treatment plan.
diagnostics.lead: A check-up is a wide examination that identifies every condition present in the mouth and assesses the state of the teeth and soft tissue. What you get out of it is an accurate diagnosis and a rational treatment plan — or, if no treatment is needed, guidance on how to care for your mouth.
points: Consultation with the chief doctor plus an examination by a therapist, prosthodontist and orthodontist
3D digital X-ray diagnostics (CT) for a deep analysis of the tissues
Photo protocol for tracking changes and the effectiveness of treatment
Assessment of hard and soft tissue, the periodontium, existing fillings and prosthetic work
After the case conference — a written plan with stages, timelines and costs

therapy-adults.title: Therapy for adults
therapy-adults.blurb: Caries, pulpitis, root canals and professional Air Flow hygiene.
therapy-adults.lead: Adult therapy covers the treatment of caries, pulpitis and root canals, as well as professional hygiene. We start with diagnostics, establish how far the damage goes and choose the most conservative method available — so that as much of your own tooth structure survives as possible.
points: Caries treatment and tooth restoration with high-quality materials
Pulpitis treatment — from conservative care through to root canal work
Root canal treatment guided by 3D tomography, under rubber dam isolation
Professional Air Flow hygiene: plaque, calculus and polishing
Every stage under anaesthetic — the procedure is painless

therapy-children.title: Therapy for children
therapy-children.blurb: A gentle approach for our youngest patients — from milk teeth to hygiene habits.
therapy-children.lead: Young patients are seen only by dentists with paediatric training. A child should visit the dentist once the first teeth appear — that lets us catch a problem at an early stage and turn the appointment into an experience they do not mind repeating.
points: Treatment of milk teeth — they matter for speech, eating and how the adult teeth come through
Early detection of caries and painless treatment
Professional hygiene on a protocol chosen specifically for children
Teaching oral care to both the child and the parent
A calm room and a pace the child sets

surgery.title: Surgery
surgery.blurb: Our experienced surgical team is ready to make your goal a reality.
surgery.lead: We turn to surgery only once every option for saving the tooth has been exhausted — and then with methods that disturb the surrounding tissue as little as possible. Every stage is explained in advance and the procedure is carried out under effective anaesthetic.
points: Tooth extraction, including piezosurgery (ultrasonic) — less bleeding and faster healing
Removal of wisdom and retained teeth with precise advance planning
Bone grafting (osteoplasty) to prepare the site for an implant
PRP plasma therapy using the patient's own blood to speed up regeneration
Post-operative care and recommendations for a quick recovery

implantation.title: Surgery and immediate implantation
implantation.blurb: Implantation at Total Charm Dent using an innovative protocol.
implantation.lead: An implant is an artificial root placed where the tooth was lost. We work with surgical guides, which give maximum accuracy in positioning the implant, and where the clinical picture allows it the implant goes in at the same appointment as the extraction.
points: Straumann (Switzerland), DENTIUM (Korea) and Bredent SKY (Germany) systems
All-on-4, All-on-6 and All-on-8 for complete tooth loss (edentulism)
Immediate implantation at the time of extraction, where the case allows
Surgical guides and 3D planning for accurate placement
Chewing function and aesthetics restored without a removable denture

periodontology.title: Periodontology
periodontology.blurb: Restore your gum health with periodontitis treatment.
periodontology.lead: Periodontitis is an inflammatory disease of the gums and the tissue that holds the tooth in place; left too long, it ends in tooth loss. We start by establishing the stage precisely and build an individual plan that addresses the cause rather than the symptom.
points: Thorough diagnosis of periodontitis and determination of its stage
Professional removal of calculus and bacterial plaque
Treatment of gum recession, including tissue regeneration methods
Treatment of inflammation and bleeding on an individual plan
Recommendations for keeping the gums healthy afterwards

orthodontics.title: Orthodontics
orthodontics.blurb: American Orthodontics (AO) — a renowned manufacturer of orthodontic braces.
orthodontics.lead: Orthodontic treatment corrects the bite at any age. American Orthodontics (AO) is a well-known US manufacturer of braces, and the system is adapted individually to each patient's anatomy.
points: A wide choice of metal, ceramic and self-ligating brackets
The self-ligating mechanism reduces friction between bracket and archwire
Strength and durability that hold up across the whole course of treatment
Precise bite correction based on individual planning
The orthodontist selects the system on the evidence from diagnostics

aligners.title: Aligners
aligners.blurb: Achieve your ideal bite with comfort and efficiency.
aligners.lead: Aligners are a set of clear trays that shift the teeth gradually. They are practically invisible, come out for eating and cleaning, and are produced from a 3D scan — which makes every stage of the correction predictable.
points: Practically invisible — bite correction without a visible appliance
Smooth material that does not irritate the soft tissue of the mouth
Removable for meals and brushing — hygiene stays straightforward
3D scanning and digital control at every stage of the correction
No meaningful restrictions on sport or everyday activity

veneers.title: Ceramic veneers
veneers.blurb: Ceramic veneers made with CAD/CAM technology.
veneers.lead: A ceramic veneer is a thin shell that covers the front surface of the tooth and corrects its shape, colour and proportion. We produce them with CAD/CAM technology — from a digital impression straight to milling — so you see the result before the work begins.
points: Minimal preparation of the tooth
Ceramic reproduces the optical behaviour of natural enamel
Corrects distorted shape, staining and minor damage
Durable — holds its colour and function for years
You approve the result in digital modelling before any work starts

digital-modelling.title: Digital modelling
digital-modelling.blurb: Digital modelling of your future smile before treatment begins.
digital-modelling.lead: Digital modelling shows you what your smile will look like before treatment starts. It makes the decision an informed one — you agree the result before we touch a tooth.
points: Visualisation of your future smile before treatment begins
An individual model built around your wishes and your anatomy
The basis for planning veneers, restorations and prosthetic work
A predictable result — no surprises at the end
Digital impressions and 3D scanning instead of conventional putty

forestadent.title: FORESTADENT braces
forestadent.blurb: The FORESTADENT bracket system is developed and manufactured in Germany.
forestadent.lead: The FORESTADENT bracket system is developed and manufactured in Germany. The range covers classic, self-ligating and aesthetic options, so the system can be matched to both the clinical need and what you want it to look like.
points: Metal, ceramic and self-ligating brackets within one system
Self-ligating models reduce the number of adjustment visits
Modern materials — high strength and durability
Individually adapted to each patient's anatomy
German manufacturing and quality control

damon.title: Damon braces
damon.blurb: The Damon bracket system is developed and manufactured in the USA.
damon.lead: Damon is a self-ligating bracket system developed and manufactured in the USA. Its sliding door mechanism reduces friction between the archwire and the bracket, which makes tooth movement more even and more predictable.
points: Self-ligating door — less friction, more predictable movement
More even pressure on the teeth and therefore less discomfort
A shorter overall treatment time
Finer control of the correction on the clinician's side
Fewer visits to the clinic for adjustments

whitening.title: Whitening ZOOM 4
whitening.blurb: Teeth whitening and cleaning with the ZOOM 4 method.
whitening.lead: ZOOM 4 (Philips ZOOM! WhiteSpeed) is currently one of the most advanced and safest ways to lighten enamel: under light, the gel releases active oxygen that penetrates deep into the tooth structure and breaks down even set-in pigmentation, including staining from age or smoking.
points: Up to eight shades or more in a single 45-minute session
Suitable for sensitive enamel — the gel does not cause demineralisation
Results last up to four years, and longer if you follow the aftercare
The gel contains amorphous calcium phosphate, which strengthens the enamel
Preparation stage: treating any decay, professional hygiene and enamel strengthening

tomography.title: Tomography
tomography.blurb: Computed tomography of the teeth and oral cavity.
tomography.lead: Computed tomography gives a three-dimensional picture of the structures inside your mouth. It is the scan that implant planning, root canal treatment and orthodontics are all built on.
points: A 3D picture of the state of the teeth, bone and gums
Precise assessment of the number, shape and curvature of the roots
Measurement of bone volume and density before implantation
A low radiation dose compared with conventional X-ray methods
Carried out on site — no need to go to another clinic for the scan

restoration.title: Dental restoration
restoration.blurb: Restoration is the art of rebuilding the shape and function of a tooth.
restoration.lead: Aesthetic restoration rebuilds the shape, structure and natural shine of a tooth using composite materials. It is used to correct shape, change colour, repair a chip and finish the treatment of decay.
points: Single-stage restoration — shape and function in one visit
Two-stage restoration modelled in wax first, for more complex cases
Professional hygiene beforehand to establish the natural enamel shade
Contouring and polishing — the restoration is indistinguishable from its neighbours
Where damage is extensive, an inlay or crown is considered instead

visiograph.title: Visiograph
visiograph.blurb: Precision and innovation for the health of your smile.
visiograph.lead: A visiograph produces digital X-ray images of the teeth and gums. The image appears on the monitor almost instantly, so the dentist can show you the detail there and then and decide with you rather than for you.
points: High resolution — even the smallest detail is visible
Digital technology lowers the radiation dose compared with conventional X-ray
The image is ready in seconds — no waiting
Convenient for checking root canal treatment stage by stage
Images are stored and can be compared at later appointments

doctor.label: Chief doctor
doctor.name: Archil Apkhadze
doctor.credentials: Maxillofacial surgeon, periodontal surgeon, implantologist, candidate of dental sciences.
doctor.bio1: More than 20 years of experience, having worked in leading clinics. He regularly sharpens his skills through conferences and seminars around the world.
doctor.bio2: Archil specialises in dental surgery, periodontology and implantology, and holds the highest professional category.

team.label: Our specialists
team.title: Professionals in their field
team.lead: At Total Charm Dental we have gathered the best doctors. Every specialist has completed an internship in European clinics, mastered modern techniques and works to international protocols. Regular training and participation in dental congresses allow them to continuously raise their level of qualification. Paediatric dentistry is handled only by doctors with the relevant specialisation and many years of experience working with children.

technology.label: Technology
technology.title: Premium digital equipment
technology.lead: We have done everything to make modern dental technology accessible to you. Premium digital equipment from European and American manufacturers allows us to:

items.title: Microscopic precision in prosthetics
items.text: During the very first visit, temporary orthopaedic constructions are created using 3D models of implants and crowns, and fixed immediately. While waiting for permanent veneers or crowns, the patient never has to experience the discomfort of missing teeth.

items.title: Innovation in aesthetic dentistry
items.text: Digital planning and predictable treatment outcomes. The patient always knows what to expect from any given treatment method.

items.title: Safe instrumental research
items.text: Instrumental examinations are carried out with maximum efficiency and safety — computed tomography is available with the lowest radiation dose.

items.title: The full spectrum of orthodontics
items.text: Selection and placement of the optimal orthodontic treatment — all types of appliances, bracket systems and aligners to create a correct bite.

items.title: Three-stage sterilisation
items.text: The safety of patients and doctors is ensured through three-stage sterilisation and control, made possible by our own top-class sterilisation department. This is an unprecedented level of processing for reusable instruments and handpieces, combined with the availability of single-use consumables in any quantity required.

technology.note: Every procedure is performed under anaesthesia. Adults and children who come to us are no longer afraid of the dentist.

care.label: Only for you
care.title: Care that continues beyond your visit
items: Appointment reminders, aftercare recommendations and monitoring of your treatment plan

A comprehensive approach to treating teeth and gums — we always look for the cause of the disease; when needed a medical council convenes, and all examinations take place in our clinic (computed tomography and panoramic imaging)
Premium care for your teeth and oral cavity
Only pleasant clinical aromas and none of the typical dental smell
Training in effective daily oral care

faq.label: Questions
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Can't find your answer? Call us or message us on WhatsApp — every day, 9:00 to 21:00.

items.a: Every procedure is performed under anaesthesia. Your dentist explains each stage in advance and works at your pace — which is why the adults and children who come to us are no longer afraid of the dentist.

items.q: How do I book a visit?
items.a: Three ways: fill in the form on this page, call us, or message us on WhatsApp. We are open every day from 9:00 to 21:00, with no closing days.

items.q: What does the first consultation cost?
items.a: A first consultation is 50 GEL; a follow-up consultation is 25 GEL. That covers the oral examination and a written treatment plan with the costs set out. You only pay for the treatment itself once you have approved the plan.
Yes. Paediatric dentistry is handled only by doctors with the relevant specialisation and many years of experience with children — from milk teeth through to teaching good hygiene habits.

The clinic has its own top-class sterilisation department and a three-stage sterilisation and control process. Reusable instruments and handpieces go through a full cycle after every patient, and single-use consumables are always stocked in the quantities required.

items.q: How many visits will my case take?
items.a: That depends on the diagnosis, which is why we start with imaging — computed tomography and digital planning. You receive the plan after your first visit, with the stages and timeline set out, so there are no surprises later.
